summary: Aris Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, reporting voting results from its Annual General Meeting held that day. The meeting covered routine items: election of eight directors, appointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, approval of amended share unit plans, and an advisory say-on-pay vote. All proposals passed with majority support. This is a standard post-meeting disclosure under Canadian NI 51-102, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine compliance report and does not trigger any special-situations category. What to watch: no event-driven angle here.
